 Dallas weather: Cold, wet weekend for North Texas starts late Saturday
 By Aaron Barker FOX 4 Weather Updated  November 14, 2026 9:46 PM CST Published  November 14, 2026 11:50 AM CST Share
 Copy Link 
 Email 
 Facebook 
 Twitter 
 LinkedIn 
 Reddit 
 Updated  November 14, 2026 9:46 PM CST ▾ Dallas weather: Nov. 14 overnight forecast 
 Fox 4 Meteorologist Kylie Capps shares the overnight forecast for November 14. 
 The Brief
 Rain chances will gradually increase during Saturday, with widespread rain expected by Saturday evening. 
 Some storms are possible as rainfall intensity increases late Saturday into Sunday morning. 
 Upwards of an inch of rain is expected in the DFW area before ending later Sunday. 
 DALLAS - Saturday will start off a cold and wet weekend for the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex.
 Timeline:
 FOX 7 Meteorologist Berkeley Taylor said that while some showers are possible during the day on Saturday, rain chances will increase toward Saturday evening.
 The heaviest rainfall is expected Sunday, especially during earlier times of the day.
 Some thunderstorms are possible as the heaviest rain moves through North Texas on Sunday. Upwards of an inch of rainfall is likely across much of the region.
 What's next:
 Drier weather is expected by Sunday evening, but temperatures will drop quickly behind the storms. Highs will struggle to reach the low 50s on Sunday and drop into the 40s Sunday night.
 Windy weather will make those lower temperatures feel even colder.
 The Source: Information in this story came from FOX 4.
